rank_up_moves: Add an explicit future test that runs full build_state after a referenced descendant-main registry audit, rather than testing epoch_validator in isolation only.
Document that an H0.x epoch is terminal after its control-doc merge; the next runtime phase starts a fresh epoch from the resulting canonical main.
risk_assessment: PASS on repair disposition: no implementation patch is required. The apparent registry-generation composability defect was based on assuming semantic validation reads the moved origin/main registry. In the active R3 checkout ContractBundle loads the epoch-local branch registry generation 67, which matches the epoch; epoch_validator then separately evaluates origin/main movement. A referenced audit can therefore authorize MAIN_MOVED_AUDIT_CONTINUE for main 8c388d / registry 68. After the explicit control-doc merge, R3 becomes historical and H0.1 must create a fresh epoch from the new canonical main, so the old R3 epoch is not required to remain active on the merge commit. Checkpoint remains blocked until the moved-main public commands are actually rerun with the referenced audit.
